name: What is the typical cost for a kitchen renovation in Berkeley?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost for a kitchen renovation in Berkeley?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a kitchen renovation in Berkeley can vary significantly based on the scope of work, materials chosen, and the size of the kitchen. Minor cosmetic updates might range from $15,000 to $30,000, while a mid-range renovation could be between $30,000 and $70,000. High-end custom kitchens with major layout changes and premium finishes can exceed $100,000. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation to understand your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen renovation costs in Berkeley vary from $15,000 for minor updates to over $100,000 for high-end custom projects, depending on scope and materials.
